history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young East Asian man with dark, slightly messy hair is intently focused on working with clay. He is wearing a white collared shirt over a white ribbed tank top, and his hands are covered in white clay. He is holding a paintbrush, carefully applying it to a small, unfinished ceramic piece that appears to be a teapot with animal-like features. The scene is set in a pottery studio, with a bright yellow pottery wheel in the foreground, splattered with clay. Behind him, on a shelf, is a collection of paintbrushes in a decorative red holder, along with other pottery tools and unfinished ceramic items. The lighting is soft and warm, creating a cozy and focused atmosphere. The color palette is dominated by earthy tones of clay, the bright yellow of the wheel, and the white of the clay and the man's clothing, with hints of darker tones in the background. The mood is one of concentration and artistic creation.
